title: How a Sink P-Trap Seals Out Sewer Gas
description: A sink P-trap uses a simple dip in the drain pipe to hold a small volume of standing water after every use. This resting water creates a continuous physical seal between the municipal sewer or septic pipe and the interior living space, preventing sewer gases from rising into the room. As fresh water flows down the drain, it replaces the old water in the trap dip. Once flow stops, gravity retains liquid up to the level of the trap weir. Maintaining correct slope and outlet wall height ensures this trap seal remains stable.

How a Sink P-Trap Seals Out Sewer Gas

A sink P-trap uses a simple dip in the drain pipe to hold a small volume of standing water after every use. This resting water creates a continuous physical seal between the municipal sewer or septic pipe and the interior living space, preventing sewer gases from rising into the room. As fresh water flows down the drain, it replaces the old water in the trap dip. Once flow stops, gravity retains liquid up to the level of the trap weir. Maintaining correct slope and outlet wall height ensures this trap seal remains stable.
